sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can describe a whole day in Hungarian, and tell someone what I did, using several actions and time connectors together.
I can talk about my family, friends and home together, and tell the story of a get-together with them.
I can describe shopping, cooking and eating out, from buying ingredients to paying the bill.
I can contrast my work life and free time, and describe how I spent a weekend.
I can explain a problem, ask for help, and tell the story of how I solved it — living confidently and independently in Hungarian.
